title: Claim Filing, Payment and Appeal Windows
content:
Time limits carried by the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders on the filing of a claim, the payment of a clean claim and the appeal of a denial.

| Rider | Days after the date of service within which a claim must reach the plan | Days within which a clean claim must be paid | Days after a denial within which the member may appeal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 365 | 30 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 365 | 30 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 365 | 30 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 365 | 30 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 365 | 21 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 365 | 21 | 60 |

Every figure in the table is a number of calendar days.

## The three windows

**The filing window** is the calendar days after the date of service within which a claim must reach the plan. It stands at 365 days on every one of the six riders.

**The payment window** is the calendar days within which the rider must pay a clean claim. It stands at 30 days on four riders and at 21 days on the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider.

**The appeal window** is the calendar days after a denial within which the member may appeal. It stands at 60 days on every one of the six riders.

## Note

Of the three windows only the payment window varies across the schedule, and it varies on the same two riders that carry the schedule's other shortened terms. The filing window at 365 days and the appeal window at 60 days are uniform across the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders.
